blocks.text: Lafz “species” biology ka ek buniyadi concept hai. Aam taur par species aise afraad (individuals) ka group hai jo qudrati halaat mein aapas mein interbreed (milap kar ke bachay paida) kar sakein aur fertile offspring (aisi aulad jo aage khud bhi bachay paida kar sake) paida karein. Ek hi species ke afraad ki khasoosiyat aur genetic makeup (genes ki banawat) milte julte hote hain, aur yahi cheez unhein doosri species ke afraad se alag karti hai.

Sirf jismani khasoosiyat (physical traits) aur shakal ki mushabahat dekh kar species pehchaanna kabhi kabhi mushkil hota hai, kyunke cryptic species bhi hoti hain: aise jandar jo dekhne mein ek jaise lagte hain lekin genetic taur par alag hote hain. Is mushkil ka hal German-American biologist Ernst Mayr ne diya: us ne reproductive isolation (aapas mein bachay paida na kar sakna) ko asal kasauti (key criterion) banaya. Is concept ke mutabiq species aapas mein interbreed karne wali qudrati aabadiyon (natural populations) ke groups hain. Mukhtalif species ke afraad aam taur par aapas mein mate nahi karte, ya aisi aulad paida nahi karte jo zinda reh sake (viable) aur fertile ho.

blocks.title: Biological species concept
blocks.text: Species aapas mein interbreed karne wali qudrati aabadiyon ka woh group hai jo doosre aise groups se reproductive taur par alag (isolated) ho. Kasauti yeh nahi ke jandar dekhne mein kaise hain, balke yeh ke kya woh aapas mein bachay paida kar ke fertile aulad de sakte hain.

blocks.title: Sirf shakal kaafi kyun nahi
blocks.text: Cryptic species ek jaisi dikhti hain lekin genetic taur par alag hoti hain aur aapas mein interbreed nahi kartin. Is ka ulta bhi hota hai: ek hi species ke afraad bohat mukhtalif dikh sakte hain, jaise kutton ki naslein (dog breeds), phir bhi woh ek hi species hain kyunke aapas mein fertile bachay paida karte hain.
